# Historical paper examples

These archives retain earlier paper examples that still belong to the
language. Version 8 listings have a `v8-` filename prefix; older archives retain
their original filenames. The evaluator runs executable cases alongside the
current [paper corpus](../paper/).

`paper.cue.txt` preserves the former listing. Executable assertions follow the
current semantics, including call-local constraints and strict arguments.
Examples requiring existential packages or dependent value binders were
removed with those language features. Mixed listings retain their valid
universal examples. The former worklist pseudocode is kept as documentation.
